outcome: Agent Computer Use is the best watched Computer Use path: visible signed cursor, accurate independent readback, and snappy per-click speed are equal to round-trip and token efficiency versus Codex bundled Computer Use (Sky/node_repl) and raw cua-driver.
non_goals: Exposing all 54 cua-driver tools as the agent vocabulary
A parallel live suite beside pointer/parity/live-validator
pass_signals: One ready MCP server; no duplicate Computer Use catalogs
Default MCP tools/list is exactly start_session, state, act, verify, end_session
CLI state --compact --query / --diff then run is the default AX loop
Live parity + pointer + elon empty-iteration stay green
AX-incomplete composers (WhatsApp/Catalyst) prove by screenshot or Voice→Send, not typed_path ok; native type-text with empty AX is ax_incomplete_value
Native AX snapshot walks an open AXSheet/AXPopover/AXDialog, else open app-level context menus then one window
Cursor plugin spawn is not {workspace}/bin/agent-computer-use-mcp; dest uses an absolute launcher with cwd ./; ~/.cursor/mcp.json does not advertise agent-computer-use unless --user-mcp
Official suite duration/max-step/bytes must not regress vs the last warm green; do not loosen budget_seconds

criteria.accuracy: Independent readback of the intended control or result; dispatch acceptance is not proof; no false-green type/click
criteria.visibility: Signed operator cursor glides to the target before AX; method agent-cursor-glide*; cursor_sync ok. Observe-only rows set pointer_required false
criteria.speed: Watched automation: total <= budget_seconds and each pointer step <= max_step_ms. A labeled click must not sit ~30s
criteria.efficiency: Asserted run for 3+ actions; fewer round-trips than N granular MCP calls
criteria.context_efficiency: No unfiltered state; --query/--diff; compact final.text; no chat dumps; parity run <12000 bytes
criteria.robustness: One owner path; All Clear|Clear; expect ignores acted control; role-scoped heading; AX 1.5s timeout; no silent pixel fallback

suite.name: calculator-8x8
suite.pass_signal: expect 64 and independent AXStaticText 64; each click agent-cursor-glide

suite.name: folder-downloads
suite.pass_signal: Downloads resolves to an actionable ancestor

suite.name: textedit-right-click
suite.pass_signal: Cursor glides; AXShowMenu/right-click shows Copy; document restored; no right-click-point

suite.name: whatsapp-new-chat
suite.pass_signal: After closed tree, cursor glides, AXHeading New chat; compact heading-only; no send. Speed clock starts after app resolve

safety: No chat dumps. No personal identifiers. No new send/payment authority. Live gate uses Calculator/TextEdit/Finder. WhatsApp benchmark is query/compact observe only; require Message yourself then (You) before any send.
baseline: Thin 5-tool MCP vs Sky ~10 methods. We win asserted CLI batches, compact query/diff, and harness portability. Cursor plugin ./bin spawn is dest-absolute after install_harness cursor-plugin.
